serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: Thanks Priestcan! 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Turns out he can read the mood after all!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: You promised to keep her existence a secret! Why are you mentioning her next to him?!
Shanice: Oh, come on. He ain’t no snitch. Besides, he is not stupid. My guess is that the first thing he did was to analyze my code that fixed him. After all, most of the things I know about coding I learned from him. College is overrated!
You: If you say so. But please, remember! I can go to jail if someone finds out about her!
Shanice: I know, I know. Don’t be so tense!
Shanice: We never had a chance to talk about it, but your girl is pretty advanced! It surprised me, really.
Shanice: I thought that only Priestbots had such advanced software, but turns out someone out there made progress in that field.
Shanice: Where did you get her from?
You: Would you believe me if I said that I found her in a ditch?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: Yeah. It’s you we are talking about after all. How else would you get your hands on something as valuable as her? It had to be by sheer luck.
You: That wasn’t a very nice thing to say…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: A ditch, huh. I really wanted to meet the one who made her, but I guess that already hit a dead end.
Shanice: Do you have any idea where she can be from or who made her?
You: None, sorry. Although when I connected her to my PC a bunch of chinese symbols came up on my screen.
Shanice: It probably has more to do with the hardware used in creating her. It’s something, but leaves nothing to pursue. Most of the sexbots were mass produced there.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: To be honest. I might have done something incredibly unnecessary. Back when I was looking through your bot’s software, I saw many interesting things.
You: Ugh, you are not talking about any videos, right?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceAngry
Shanice: What?! Of course not!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: Remember when I mentioned that someone made progress in the bot software? The thing is, it shouldn’t be possible. 
Shanice: Teams of researchers tried to recreate and improve what John Paul 202 made, but they all failed. It is considered a dead field. Yet, your bot has some insane lines of code, a leap in the technology!
Shanice: Whoever did this, is a genius. That’s why I need to meet him. 
Shanice: There is also that other thing…
